about_the_game:
The Story Begins

Thirteen-year-old Willow wakes up from a nightmare in an unfamiliar hospital. Her memories are clouded, and her heart is filled with anxiety because her brother William is nowhere to be seen. Trapped with the strange children who advise her to forget about her brother, Willow is determined to find William and escape this strange place. But how to survive in a hospital taken over by monsters and not lose the remnants of hope?

In this mystery point-and-click adventure, you play as Willow, a brave girl in a difficult situation. Look for objects and solve puzzles in the arcane hospital, hide from the shadows, talk to patients, and learn their stories. And remember: the most precious things are the easiest to lose.

Key Features

  • An immersive story-driven mystery adventure.

  • Branching Narrative. Choose how Willow approaches the challenges on her journey. Will she be kind to people around and solve their problems, or sacrifice everyone in search of her brother?

  • An obscure world made for exploration, filled with secrets and puzzles for you to solve.

  • Unique paper theater mechanics: shape the world around you and move forward with the power of paper and ink.
